findings: Thin pale, slightly speckled fringe follows portions of the hair, clothing and limb contours on the dark background; limited to the cutout edge and does not obscure the illustration.

Thin pale broken fringe outlines portions of the rack, plates, bench and athlete on dark backgrounds; especially visible around female ponytails. Limited to edges, with no substantial opaque background or enclosed checkerboard visible.

Bench/rack uprights, base feet and planted shoes shift modestly horizontally between frames. These stationary anchor changes are separate from the intended bar and arm motion; overall scale and identity remain broadly consistent.

Thin light fringe follows parts of the athlete and bench contours on dark backgrounds. White shoe sole strips show irregular transparent breaks, most conspicuous in male frame 0, which also has small pale flecks beneath the soles. Illustration remains usable; no substantial background block or enclosed checkerboard is visible.

Female frame 0 places bench and feet slightly lower than subsequent frames; bench legs and foot positions vary slightly through the sequence. This is limited stationary-anchor drift rather than the intended arm press motion.

The male bar changes apparent width and bend geometry across the curl, and its band connections change from wrapped loops in frame 0 to carabiner-like fittings in frames 1–3. Equipment remains recognizable and connected, but this produces a small continuity mismatch.
Male frame 3 and female frame 2 introduce visibly denser speckled clothing texture than the neighboring frames, causing a small shading/style discontinuity.

Foot outlines and stance width shift slightly across otherwise stationary standing poses, most evident in male frame 3 and female frames 1–3. Overall figure scale is similar and no severe jump or clipping is visible.

Small opaque white wedges remain in the gap between the image-right arm and torso; frames 1 and 3 also show white in the opposite bent-arm gap. These remain white against the dark background. Localized remnants do not obscure the movement.

Thin pale fringe and scattered tiny edge flecks are visible around silhouettes on dark backgrounds, especially shoes and portions of head/limb contours. Female shoe edges have the clearest small stray marks. No large background field or clipping.
Thin pale outlines trace portions of the body, handles and bands against dark backgrounds. Artwork remains usable; no substantial exterior background remains.

The small opaque pale ground oval beneath the feet contains blocky/checker-like tonal patches and stands out on dark backgrounds. Its oval shape appears intentional, but its patterned texture warrants review.

Fine light-gray/white contour residue is visible against black along portions of the body, shoes, hair, and enclosed gaps. It is narrow and does not obscure anatomy or materially compromise the illustration. Light-background presentation is substantially cleaner.

Thin pale, intermittently dotted fringe follows portions of the cutout contours on dark backgrounds, especially hair, arms, shoes and ground ellipses. Light-background rendering is largely clean; no substantial opaque background or checkerboard interiors observed.

Male ground ellipse and planted shoe rise modestly through frames 1 and 2, then return lower in frame 3. This creates a limited ground-anchor shift beyond the expected torso lowering during the lunge.

Thin pale, intermittently dotted fringe traces portions of the hair, arms, torso, legs and equipment on dark backgrounds. Limited to the perimeter; illustrations remain usable. No large opaque background, enclosed checkerboard residue, substantial unwanted holes or clipping seen.
Enclosed sole bands and lace details switch from light to dark with the preview background, indicating cut-out footwear interiors. The affected areas are small and the illustrations remain usable.
